---
name: Bug report
about: Something is broken or behaving unexpectedly
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

**What happened?**
A clear description of the bug. If unsure whether something is a bug or a design choice, ask anyway — we would rather hear about it twice than never.

**What did you expect to happen?**
What you thought should happen instead.

**How can we reproduce it?**
Steps, e.g.:

1. Go to '#/map'
2. Click on a waterlogging event marker
3. See error

Deep links are appreciated — the app is a single route with hash views (e.g. `#/events/UE-2026-0001`).

**Which view or area?**
Check all that apply:

- [ ] Command Center (`#/`)
- [ ] Waterlogging Map (`#/map`)
- [ ] Event Dossier (`#/events/...`)
- [ ] Investigate (`#/investigate`)
- [ ] Responsibility (`#/responsibility`)
- [ ] Verification (`#/verify`)
- [ ] Report Wizard (`#/report`)
- [ ] Analytics (`#/analytics`)
- [ ] Data & Model Health (`#/health`)
- [ ] Something else (shell, SEO, docs, build, CI, deploy)

**Environment**

- Browser (and version):
- Device / OS:
- Screen size (roughly): desktop / tablet / mobile

**Screenshots or console output**
If handy, paste a screenshot or the exact console text. Redact anything personal.

**Honest-data check (please read)**
All seeded records are synthetic demo data (`SYNTHETIC_DEMO`) and AI output is
model-generated. Does the bug involve something being presented as real or
live when it should be labelled? [ ] Yes [ ] No [ ] Not sure
